description: Check street parking at a New Orleans address, cross street or landmark (e.g. 'Superdome', '800 Magazine St', 'Frenchmen and Chartres'). Returns a plain-language verdict (looks easy / check the signs / tow risk), the rule most likely to get a car towed, what parking costs now, nearby events or parades that change the answer, the easiest nearby streets, and a link to the live Easy Lane page. Use this whenever someone asks where or whether they can park in New Orleans.

address.description: Address, cross street or landmark in New Orleans.

stay_hours.description: How long they'll stay parked, in hours. Adds what changes during the stay: meters starting, permit-zone 2-hour limits, parades, events and temporary no-parking zones.

when.description: When they'll park, as an ISO date-time. Defaults to now.

name: check_parking
title: Can I park here? (New Orleans)
